item.title: Malaysia’s Drive to Build a High-Value Technology Ecosystem
item.description: Malaysia is strengthening its technology ecosystem by developing domestic semiconductor design, advanced packaging, talent and research capabilities to drive innovation and high-value industrial growth.

item.title: Australia: Real-Time Bridge Monitoring for Safer Victoria Roads
item.description: Victoria has completed a trial of real-time Bridge Weigh-In-Motion technology on the Western Freeway, using advanced sensors to monitor heavy vehicle loads and support data-driven infrastructure planning.

item.title: India Advances National Strategy for AI Skills and Digital Readiness
item.description: India is rapidly expanding AI education across schools, universities and national digital platforms to build a future-ready, highly skilled workforce and meet the rapidly rising demand for trained AI professionals.

item.title: University of Hong Kong Expands AI Research into Real-World Robotics
item.description: HKU has launched a collaborative research initiative in Hong Kong to advance embodied AI and next-generation robotics, translating theoretical AI into practical, real-world intelligent machines.

item.title: Vietnam: Digital Infrastructure Powers Transparent Elections
item.description: Vietnam is leveraging digital technologies, including voter databases, QR codes, digital maps and chatbots, to enhance transparency, accuracy, efficiency, reliability, accessibility and citizen engagement in the 2026 elections.

item.title: Singapore: Ensuring Safe and Sustainable AI Implementation
item.description: Singapore’s National AI Impact Programme drives widespread adoption across businesses while developing skilled “AI bilingual” workers, embedding sustainability, productivity and safeguards against digital threats.

item.title: Exclusive! The Digital Nervous System: Intelligence Without Limits for An Always-On World
item.description: In Singapore’s hyperconnected landscape, AI-powered networks transform connectivity into intelligence, helping organisations anticipate change and operate with resilience.

item.title: Malaysia: AI Sensors Improve Pedestrian Safety in Subang Jaya
Hong Kong: ASTRI Explores AI Tools for Engineering Operations
item.description: A Hong Kong research collaboration explores AI technologies including document intelligence, speech analytics and CAD analysis to improve infrastructure operations, compliance monitoring and efficiency.

item.title: Singapore Strengthens Technology and Innovation Leadership
item.description: Singapore’s COS 2026 outlines A*STAR-led initiatives to advance AI, semiconductor and biomedical research and low-carbon technologies, strengthening the nation’s innovation ecosystem and future-ready economy.
